title: Households.list privilege escalation: empty accessibleNodeIds returns all households
note: Non-admin with empty accessibleNodeIds falls through to null (unrestricted) at guards.ts:90. Root: ternary `accessibleNodeIds.length > 0 ? accessibleNodeIds : null` returns null for empty arrays.

title: walk-in-customers.list hardcoded to return empty — deprecated endpoints throw instead
note: list() returns {items:[], total:0} unconditionally. getById/create/update/deactivate throw BAD_REQUEST (correct). list() should either throw or be removed to avoid confusion.

title: GHL sync failure in invitation acceptance is silently swallowed
note: Documented 'Failure mode B' — intentional, but means member created in Avantej without GHL contact on GHL failure. No retry mechanism or alert.

title: updateRole does not write audit log (updateScope does)
note: Inconsistent audit coverage between updateRole and updateScope.

title: POS accepts stripe/online payment method without validating org has Stripe enabled
note: Org feature-flag check for Stripe not present. Creates pending payments that never resolve if Stripe not configured.

persistence.expect: rejected if org has no Stripe account

title: Installment reschedule does not re-evaluate overdue lock; waive does not auto-unlock when all paid
note: Rescheduled installment can remain 'locked' with a past due-date. Waiving final installment doesn't unlock the package.

title: Promo code not re-validated at recordPosSale if deactivated after frontend validate call
note: Frontend caches validatePromoCode result; promo deactivated between validate and submit still applies.

title: Tax rate silently defaults to 0 if no explicit rate and no org default
note: No explicit error when no active tax rate configured — sale proceeds with 0% tax.

persistence.expect: should require explicit tax rate or reject

title: Commission reversal not triggered when sales order is CANCELLED (void path)
note: reverseForRefund IS called for refund approval (refunds.service.ts:644). The gap is voidCommissionSplitsForSalesOrder does not create reversal audit rows — finance cannot track why splits were voided on cancellation.

title: Waitlist promotion race condition: spotsBooked incremented without capacity check
note: sql`spotsBooked + 1` runs without WHERE spotsBooked < capacity. Concurrent promotions can exceed capacity.

title: listForUser does not expand virtual recurrences — clients see only parent appointment
note: listForUser calls listAppointmentsForUser (not listAppointmentsWithRecurrence). Virtual occurrences never returned to client app.

title: Check-in does not validate appointmentClientId exists or belongs to client
note: Orphaned check_in rows possible if invalid appointmentClientId supplied.

title: Class slot capacity can be reduced below current spotsBooked
note: No validation that new capacity >= spotsBooked; negative spotsAvailable possible.

title: Appointment reschedule does not check trainer availability exceptions
note: Update/reschedule does not validate new time against trainer availability exceptions.

title: bulkApprove auto-confirms first installment with hardcoded 'manual_transfer' — no payment proof required
note: When installmentsTotal>1 && installmentsPaid==0, first installment unconditionally marked confirmed with paymentMethod='manual_transfer'. No receipt or proof captured.

title: setBranchPrice null branchId bypasses branch access guard
note: guardInputBranchForContext returns immediately when branchId is null/undefined. Regional admin can call setBranchPrice with branchId:null to set org-wide pricing.

title: createTrainerTier does not scaffold commission_tier_rates rows; commission calc fails if rates not set
note: missingRateCategories returned to caller but no stub rows created. Commission calculation fails for trainers assigned to a tier with no rates.

title: Freeze/resume managed by two independent code paths — race condition loses audit
note: lifecycle.procedures freeze/unfreeze and memberships router freezeMembership/resumeMembership both write packageInstances row independently. Last write wins.

title: Goods receipt creation does not advance PO status
note: goods-receipt.service.ts DOES update stock (confirmed). But PO status (draft→partial→received) is NOT updated when receipt is created.

title: Payout batch runBatch does not validate splits are status=approved before paying
note: Approval workflow bypass possible — pending splits could be paid without approval step.

title: Category commission slot weightages not validated to sum 10000 bps at upsert
note: Sum(weightageBasisPoints) is only asserted at calculation time (warning, not error). Misconfigured commission rules silently produce wrong splits.

title: Product price override accepts effectiveUntil < effectiveFrom without validation
note: Inverted date ranges silently produce price overrides that never activate.

title: Announcements scopes written but no notification dispatched to members
note: announcement_scopes M-to-M created correctly. No notification dispatch to members in scopes. requiresAcknowledgement never enforced.

persistence.expect: notification rows created for scoped members

title: Notifications table written but no email/SMS/push dispatcher exists
note: Notifications visible in UI but users never receive them externally. Backend infrastructure gap.

title: Scheduled reports CRUD works but no cron/job handler executes them
note: listDueScheduledReports() exists but no Cloudflare scheduled handler or cron job calls it.

title: Member hierarchy reassignment accepts any target scope without RBAC validation
note: Reassign accepts any newHierarchyScopeId. RBAC bypass: regional manager can reassign member to out-of-scope branch.

persistence.expect: FORBIDDEN when targetScope outside caller's accessibleNodeIds
